name: @veltravia/memory-core
description: Veltravia AI Project Memory & Knowledge System core: typed, project-scoped knowledge records with explicit provenance, structured confidence, a validated lifecycle (candidate -> active -> archived), bounded search, bounded AI context construction, and conservative candidate extraction from completed workflows. Memory is REFERENCE DATA, never an authority layer: it can never change policies, permissions, confirmations, sandbox restrictions, or tool authorization. No secrets, no cross-project access, no unbounded growth.
